pull_request.title: refactor: consolidate error handling patterns
pull_request.body:
## Summary

Standardizes all error handling in the `cargo-cost-lint` crate using a custom `Error` enum and `Result` type alias, replacing inconsistent `unwrap()`/`expect()` calls with proper error propagation.

Closes #194

## Changes

### `cargo-cost-lint/build.rs`
- Added custom `Error` enum with variants: `Io`, `MissingEnv`, `Parse`
- Implemented `Display`, `Error` (std::error::Error), and `From<std::io::Error>`
- Added `Result<T>` type alias
- Refactored `main()` to delegate to `run()` and handle errors gracefully

### `cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs`
- Added custom `Error` enum with variants: `Io`, `Dylint(String)`
- Implemented `Display`, `Error`, and `From<std::io::Error>`
- Added `Result<T>` type alias
- Refactored `main()` to delegate to `run() -> Result<i32>`
- Replaced `.expect()` calls with `?` propagation and `.ok_or_else()`
- Propagate config file I/O errors instead of silently swallowing them
- Fixed `Result::ok` shadowing by using `std::result::Result::ok` in `allowed_files()`
- Test code retains `.unwrap()` (idiomatic for Rust tests)

## Verification

- ✅ `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — passes
- ✅ `cargo clippy -p cargo-cost-lint --all-targets -- -D warnings` — no warnings
- ✅ `cargo test -p cargo-cost-lint` — all 6 unit tests pass

commits.message:
refactor: consolidate error handling in cargo-cost-lint

Replace unwrap/expect calls with a custom Error enum and Result type
in both build.rs and main.rs for consistent, propagatable error handling.

- build.rs: Error::{Io, MissingEnv, Parse} with Display, Error, From impls
- main.rs: Error::{Io, Dylint} with Display, Error, From impls
- Propagate config file I/O errors instead of silently swallowing them
- Fix Result::ok shadowing by using fully-qualified std::result::Result::ok

Closes #194

Hi @chiprime 👋

This PR currently has **merge conflicts with `main`** and can't be merged as-is. Please resolve them so we can move forward with the review.

```bash
git remote add upstream https://github.com/Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter.git   # if not already added
git fetch upstream
git checkout <your-branch>
git rebase upstream/main      # or: git merge upstream/main
# resolve the conflicted files, then:
git add .
git rebase --continue         # or: git commit  (if you merged)
git push --force-with-lease    # plain 'git push' if you merged instead of rebased
```

A couple of reminders while you're at it:
- Make sure the branch still builds and `cargo test` passes after the rebase.
- Commit messages must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) — CI enforces this.

Ping us here once it's updated and we'll re-review. Thanks for contributing! 🙏
